t2.title: Advertising of alcohol be banned
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should advertising of alcohol be banned?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Alcohol advertising is a controversial topic. I believe stricter regulations are needed, though a complete ban may be excessive.

Firstly, alcohol ads influence young people. Research shows exposure to alcohol marketing increases likelihood of drinking among teenagers. Banning ads could protect vulnerable groups from harmful influences.

Secondly, alcohol causes significant health problems. It contributes to liver disease, addiction, and accidents. Reducing advertising could decrease consumption and related social costs.

However, complete bans raise concerns. Freedom of expression and business rights must be considered. Moreover, bans may not be effective – alcohol is deeply embedded in many cultures.

Nevertheless, middle-ground approaches exist. Restricting ads during children's programming, banning sports sponsorships, and requiring health warnings can limit exposure without total prohibition.

Furthermore, education about responsible drinking is equally important as advertising restrictions.

In conclusion, while total bans are impractical, alcohol advertising should face stronger regulations to protect public health, especially among youth.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
I like beer. Ads are okay. I see beer ads on TV. Beer is good. Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,
I think alcohol ads are okay, but maybe not for kids. I see them on TV and sometimes I want to buy the beer. But alcohol is bad for you if you drink too much. So maybe no ads for kids because they are young. And it's bad to drink too much. Thank you.
t2.sampleB1: I think advertising alcohol is a difficult topic. In my opinion, it's okay to advertise, but there should be some rules. For example, maybe they shouldn't show ads during kids' TV shows because kids might want to drink alcohol when they see it. Also, alcohol can be bad for your health if you drink too much. So, maybe the ads should say something about drinking responsibly. However, it's up to adults to decide if they want to drink or not. It's their choice. Some people enjoy drinking alcohol, but it's important to be careful. I think more education about alcohol is important too.
t2.sampleB2: Great topic — this is something I've thought about quite a bit, so I'll throw in my two cents. Personally, I don't think a total ban is the answer, but I do believe alcohol advertising needs tighter controls. My main concern is the impact on young people. Slick, glamorous ads tend to normalise drinking and make it look like the key to a good night out. Teenagers are especially easily influenced, and shielding them from this kind of marketing would be a step in the right direction. On the other hand, we can't ignore the fact that alcohol is a legal product. A blanket ban would hit the industry hard and probably drive the problem underground rather than solve it. To me, the sensible middle ground is restricting ads during children's programming, banning celebrity endorsements, and making health warnings compulsory. At the end of the day, education matters just as much as regulation. Teaching people to drink responsibly is what really makes a difference. What do you all think — would tougher rules actually change behaviour, or is it a waste of time? I'd love to hear your views!
t2.uzSample:
Spirtli ichimliklar reklamasi bahsli mavzu. Menimcha, qat'iyroq qoidalarga ehtiyoj bor, garchi to'liq taqiq haddan tashqari bo'lishi mumkin.

Birinchidan, spirtli ichimliklar reklamasi yoshlarga ta'sir qiladi. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, spirtli ichimliklar marketingiga ta'sir qilish o'smirlar orasida ichish ehtimolini oshiradi. Reklamalarni taqiqlash zaif guruhlarni zararli ta'sirlardan himoya qilishi mumkin.

Ikkinchidan, spirtli ichimliklar jiddiy sog'liq muammolariga olib keladi. U jigar kasalliklari, giyohvandlik va baxtsiz hodisalarga sabab bo'ladi. Reklamani kamaytirish iste'molni va tegishli ijtimoiy xarajatlarni kamaytirishi mumkin.

Biroq, to'liq taqiqlar xavotirlarni uyg'otadi. So'z erkinligi va biznes huquqlari hisobga olinishi kerak. Bundan tashqari, taqiqlar samarali bo'lmasligi mumkin - spirtli ichimliklar ko'plab madaniyatlarga chuqur singib ketgan.

Shunga qaramay, o'rta yo'l yechimlari mavjud. Bolalar dasturlari davomida reklamalarni cheklash, sport homiyligini taqiqlash va sog'liq haqida ogohlantirishlarni talab qilish to'liq taqiqlamasdan ta'sirni cheklashi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, mas'uliyatli ichish haqida ta'lim berish reklama cheklovlari kabi bir xilda muhimdir.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, to'liq taqiqlar amaliy bo'lmasa-da, spirtli ichimliklar reklamasi jamoat salomatligini, ayniqsa, yoshlar orasida himoya qilish uchun kuchliroq qoidalarga duch kelishi kerak.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Men pivoni yaxshi ko'raman. Reklamalar yaxshi. Men televizorda pivo reklamasini ko'raman. Pivo yaxshi. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,
Menimcha, alkogol reklamalari yaxshi, lekin bolalar uchun emas. Men ularni televizorda ko'raman va ba'zan pivo sotib olgim keladi. Lekin agar ko'p ichsangiz, alkogol siz uchun yomon. Shuning uchun, ehtimol, bolalar uchun reklama bo'lmasligi kerak, chunki ular yosh. Va juda ko'p ichish yomon. Rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB1: Menimcha, alkogolni reklama qilish qiyin mavzu. Mening fikrimcha, reklama qilish yaxshi, lekin ba'zi qoidalar bo'lishi kerak. Misol uchun, ehtimol, ular bolalar teleko'rsatuvlari paytida reklamalarni ko'rsatmasliklari kerak, chunki bolalar uni ko'rganda alkogol ichishni xohlashlari mumkin. Bundan tashqari, agar siz juda ko'p ichsangiz, alkogol sog'lig'ingiz uchun yomon bo'lishi mumkin. Shunday qilib, ehtimol, reklamalar mas'uliyat bilan ichish haqida biror narsa deyishi kerak. Biroq, ichishni xohlash yoki yo'qligini hal qilish kattalarning vazifasi. Bu ularning tanlovi. Ba'zi odamlar alkogol ichishdan zavqlanishadi, lekin ehtiyot bo'lish muhim. Menimcha, alkogol haqida ko'proq ma'lumot berish ham muhim.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Spirtli ichimliklar reklamalarini taqiqlash kerakmi degan savol murakkab. To'liq taqiq juda ekstremal bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, men potentsial zararni, ayniqsa zaif aholi guruhlariga yetkazilishini kamaytirish uchun qat'iyroq nazorat zarur deb hisoblayman.

Bir tomondan, reklama ichish odatlariga, ayniqsa yoshlar orasida sezilarli ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin. Jozibali reklamalarga duch kelish spirtli ichimliklarni iste'mol qilishni normallashtirishi va erta tajriba o'tkazishga undashi mumkin, bu esa giyohvandlikka olib kelishi mumkin. Bunday reklamalarni taqiqlash yoki cheklash voyaga yetmaganlarni bu ta'sirlardan himoya qilishi mumkin.

Boshqa tomondan, to'liq taqiq so'z erkinligini buzishi va spirtli ichimliklar sanoatiga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin. Tegishli sog'liqni saqlash ogohlantirishlari bilan mas'uliyatli reklama iste'molchilarni ma'lumot bilan ta'minlashi, shu bilan birga biznesga o'z mahsulotlarini targ'ib qilish imkoniyatini berishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, agar odamlar spirtli ichimliklarni boshqa yo'llar bilan olishlari mumkin bo'lsa, taqiq samarali bo'lmasligi mumkin.

Oxir oqibat, muvozanatli yondashuv zarur. Bu bolalar tomosha qilishi mumkin bo'lgan vaqtlarda reklamani cheklashni, mashhurlarning ma'qullashini taqiqlashni va barcha spirtli ichimliklar reklamalarida majburiy sog'liqni saqlash ogohlantirishlarini joriy etishni o'z ichiga olishi mumkin. Spirtli ichimliklarni suiiste'mol qilish xavfi haqida ta'lim berish ham juda muhimdir.

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is looking for a nice place for a casual evening out. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! I know you're looking for somewhere nice to hang out. I recently visited HopCraft Brewery and the atmosphere was amazing! Great craft beers, tasty snacks, and really friendly staff. Perfect for a casual evening! You should definitely check it out! Take care!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Aziz,
I go to HopCraft. Beer good. Nice. You go!
Bye.
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Aziz,

See you!

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the craft brewery. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear HopCraft Team, Thank you for asking about my experience at your craft brewery. I was thoroughly impressed with my visit. The beer selection was incredibly diverse, and the tasting flight helped me discover new favorites. Your staff were extremely knowledgeable and passionate about brewing. However, I have some suggestions. The food menu was rather limited – more substantial dishes would be welcome. Additionally, the venue became quite noisy on weekend evenings. I would love to see brewery tours explaining the brewing process. Live music nights would enhance the atmosphere. Also, offering a loyalty program for regular visitors would be appreciated. Overall, HopCraft is now my go-to spot for quality drinks. Yours sincerely, Muattar Qodirova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi HopCraft,

Beer good. I like beer. Staff ok. More beer?

Bye
t12.sampleA2:
Dear HopCraft,

I went to your brewery. The beer was good, and I liked the place. But it was a bit loud. I think you need more food because I was hungry. More beer is good too.

Thank you,

Muattar Qodirova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear HopCraft Team,

Thank you for asking about my visit. I enjoyed the beer, and the staff were friendly. I especially liked the IPA.

However, I think there are some things you could improve. For example, the music was a little too loud. Also, it was hard to find a seat because it was so busy. I think you should have more tables.

In my opinion, you could also offer some snacks with the beer. Maybe some pretzels or nuts? Overall, I had a good time, and I will come back again.

Sincerely,
Muattar Qodirova
t12.sampleB2: Dear HopCraft Team, Thank you for inviting feedback on my recent visit to your brewery. I am pleased to say I thoroughly enjoyed the experience and left with a very positive impression. Your beer selection was impressively varied, and the tasting flight made it easy to settle on a new favourite. I was also struck by how knowledgeable and welcoming your staff were throughout the evening. That said, I would like to offer a few suggestions. The food menu felt somewhat limited, so a wider range of hearty dishes would go down well. In addition, hosting live music nights or short brewery tours would add to the appeal and encourage regulars to return. Overall, HopCraft has quickly become my go-to spot, and I look forward to seeing how it develops. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli HopCraft jamoasi,

Sizning hunarmand pivo zavodingizdagi tajribam haqida so'raganingiz uchun rahmat.

Mening tashrifim menga juda katta taassurot qoldirdi. Pivo tanlovi nihoyatda xilma-xil edi va degustatsiya to'plami menga yangi sevimli turlarni kashf etishga yordam berdi. Sizning xodimlaringiz pivo tayyorlash bo'yicha juda bilimli va ishtiyoqli edilar.

Biroq, menda ba'zi takliflar bor. Taomlar menyusi ancha cheklangan edi – yanada to'yimli taomlar juda yaxshi bo'lardi. Bundan tashqari, dam olish kunlari kechqurunlari joy juda shovqinli bo'lib qoldi.

Pivo tayyorlash jarayonini tushuntiruvchi pivo zavodi ekskursiyalarini ko'rishni juda xohlardim. Jonli musiqa kechalari muhitni yanada yaxshilaydi. Shuningdek, doimiy tashrif buyuruvchilar uchun sodiqlik dasturini taklif qilish qadrlanadi.

Umuman olganda, HopCraft hozirda sifatli ichimliklar uchun mening eng sevimli joyimga aylandi.

Hurmat bilan, Muattar Qodirova
t12.uzSampleA1:
Salom, HopCraft,

Pivo yaxshi. Menga pivo yoqadi. Xodimlar yaxshi. Yana pivo bormi?

Xayr
t12.uzSampleA2:
Hurmatli HopCraft,

Men sizning pivo zavodingizga bordim. Pivo yaxshi edi va menga joy yoqdi. Lekin biroz shovqinli edi. O'ylashimcha, sizga ko'proq ovqat kerak, chunki men och edim. Ko'proq pivo ham yaxshi.

Rahmat,

Muattar Qodirova
t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli HopCraft jamoasi,

Tashrifim haqida so'raganingiz uchun rahmat. Menga pivo yoqdi va xodimlar do'stona edilar. Ayniqsa, IPA menga juda yoqdi.

Biroq, menimcha, siz yaxshilashingiz mumkin bo'lgan ba'zi narsalar bor. Masalan, musiqa biroz baland edi. Shuningdek, juda gavjum bo'lgani uchun o'tiradigan joy topish qiyin edi. Menimcha, sizda ko'proq stol bo'lishi kerak.

Mening fikrimcha, siz pivo bilan birga ba'zi gazaklar ham taklif qilishingiz mumkin. Ehtimol, tuzlangan non yoki yong'oqlar? Umuman olganda, men yaxshi vaqt o'tkazdim va yana qaytib kelaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Muattar Qodirova
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli HopCraft jamoasi,

HopCraft pivo zavodiga yaqinda tashrif buyurganim yuzasidan javob xatingiz uchun rahmat. O'z taassurotlarimni baham ko'rmoqchiman va ba'zi konstruktiv takliflar bermoqchiman.

Umuman olganda, men tajribadan juda mamnun bo'ldim. Pivo tanlovi xilma-xil bo'lib, turli xil didlarga mos keladi. Xodimlar odatda e'tiborli va foydali tavsiyalar bera olishdi. Biroq, muhitni yaxshilash mumkin. Yorug'lik biroz qo'pol tuyuldi va akustika taproom gavjum bo'lganda suhbatlashishni qiyinlashtirdi.

Takliflarga kelsak, menimcha, HopCraft alkogolsiz ichimliklarning kengroq assortimentini taklif qilishdan foyda ko'rishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, agar imkoni bo'lsa, tashqi o'rindiqlarni ta'minlash, ayniqsa, iliq oylarda katta e'tiborga sazovor bo'ladi. Nihoyat, yanada xilma-xil kulinar tajribani taklif qilish uchun mahalliy oziq-ovqat yuk mashinalari bilan hamkorlik qilishni ko'rib chiqing.

Sifatga sodiqligingiz va mijozlarning fikrini so'raganingiz uchun tashakkur. HopCraftning rivojlanishda davom etishini ko'rishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Muattar Qodirova
